provenance: Restored source manifest from the original authored and primary-source-verified manifest after workspace loss; this is source metadata, not recovered benchmark outputs.
scope: Seven CPU models; both Qwen entries excluded by latest user instruction

models.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

models.pooling: Use exported sentence_embedding, which includes mean pooling and learned dense layers; do not re-pool last_hidden_state
models.provenance: HF ONNX conversion linked by official HF announcement https://huggingface.co/blog/embeddinggemma; original google/embeddinggemma-300m is gated and not used

models.runtime: gliner2.AutoExtractor or gliner2.classification.Classifier; not legacy GLiNER2
models.runtime_package: gliner2==2.0.0 from PyPI; do not equate its entire source tree to inspected GitHub HEAD
models.runtime_constraint: transformers>=4.38,<5 in gliner2[local]; use separate environment
models.preflight: processor.collate_fn_inference([(state, compiled.build())], max_len=None, error_policy="raise"); exact token count int(batch.attention_mask[0].sum())

models.notes: Use shipped calibrator per_k, not README historical T=1.0716. Pinned per_k[3]=5.0069; default2.8039. Slice unused ONNX logits before softmax. ORT intra/inter allow_spinning=0.

models.runtime_constraint: laya==0.3.23; torch>=2.0; transformers>=4.48, no upper limit declared
models.notes: Use direct multilingual agent, never automatic Router, which could switch to421MEnglish. Author says multilingual ships uncalibrated. Native probabilities round4decimals. No fast or compile path.

models.runtime: Repository Python package julia; engine.logits(rows) batched; strict_encoding=True; backend=torch; compile_model=False; encoding_cache=0; token_cache=0
models.runtime_constraint: Python>=3.11; torch>=2.6; transformers>=5.0,<5.1; safetensors>=0.5; numpy>=1.26. Separate environment required.
models.files_policy: Download complete official repository, including Python runtime. Images may be skipped. Do not substitute generic AutoModel.

adapter_protocol.task: Binary relevance over shared first-stage shortlist
adapter_protocol.optional_query_truncation: truncate_query=True enables audited per-pair right-prefix truncation of query only. Full candidate and labels remain intact.
adapter_protocol.runtime_notes: Julia encoding/token caches disabled. Verdict ONNX idle spinning disabled. GLiNER2.0.0 exact token preflight uses public collate_fn_inference with error_policy=raise.

benchmark_notes: Shared shortlist+classifier is a retrieval pipeline; report first-stage candidate recall separately.
Do not compare current SkillRet6006/4392 results with original6660/4997 as the same test.
Model card latency figures are not CPU benchmark measurements.
